name: Blackwing Descent
initial_boss_state_source: instance_blackwing_descent.cpp:138-143 Create() does not call InstanceScript::Create(), so untouched bosses stay TO_BE_DECIDED; SaveToDB writes them as 5 and ReadSaveDataBossStates skips 5 (InstanceScript.cpp:498-511)

sources.credit_entries: live world DB (trinity-cata-db, read-only SELECTs on creature, spawn_group, spawn_group_template, creature_summon_groups and instance_encounters, 2026-09-25): instance_encounters 1022-1027
sources.save_format: src/server/game/Instances/InstanceScript.cpp:514-538 (header chars and spaces, uint32 states and spaces, WriteSaveDataMore)
sources.spawns: live world DB (trinity-cata-db, read-only SELECTs on creature, spawn_group, spawn_group_template, creature_summon_groups and instance_encounters, 2026-09-25): database spawns of Magmaw 41570, Omnotron controller 42186, Chimaeron 43296 and Maloriak 41378 (no spawn group); no spawn of Atramedes 41442, Nefarian 41376 or Onyxia 41270; golems summoned by 42186 and Onyxia by 41376 (creature_summon_groups); Lord Victor Nefarius 41379 in manual spawn group 402

bosses.name: Omnotron Defense System
sources: blackwing_descent.h:91 BOSS_OMNOTRON = 42186 (the controller; 42166 is Arcanotron, a golem)
boss_omnotron_defense_system.cpp:239-244 the controller summons the four golems only while the encounter is not DONE
boss_omnotron_defense_system.cpp:337-345 ACTION_FINISH_ENCOUNTER calls _JustDied on the controller, which does not kill it; the golems are summons
bosses.notes: The live kill credit is Toxitron (42180), the golem whose death ends the encounter; the seeder sets the completed-encounter bit from DungeonEncounter.dbc.
bosses.spawn_notes: The controller 42186 survives a natural clear; the four golems are summoned by it (boss_omnotron_defense_system.cpp:239-244) and must have no ungated database spawn.

bosses.name: Chimaeron
sources: instance_blackwing_descent.cpp:69-74 inner chamber door 205830 is a PASSAGE door of both Magmaw and Omnotron
instance_blackwing_descent.cpp:215-218 the door is opened on creation only when Magmaw and Omnotron are DONE

bosses.name: Atramedes
sources: instance_blackwing_descent.cpp:298-316 the intro state becomes DONE when all 8 dwarven spirits die
instance_blackwing_descent.cpp:333-348,458-461,494-495 Atramedes is summoned by the instance script, so a natural kill needs the intro DONE
bosses.spawn_notes: Atramedes is summoned by the instance script (instance_blackwing_descent.cpp:333-348,458-461,494-495).

bosses.name: Nefarian's End
sources: instance_blackwing_descent.cpp:520-530 IsNefarianAvailable needs the other five DONE
instance_blackwing_descent.cpp:287-289,503-504 spawn group 402 is spawned only then
bosses.spawn_notes: Nefarian is summoned by Lord Victor Nefarius (boss_nefarians_end.cpp:1087). Onyxia must be summoned or in a manual spawn group (402 is spawned only while Nefarian is not DONE, instance_blackwing_descent.cpp:287-289,503-504); a database spawn outside one refuses seeding.

save_extras.name: atramedes_intro_state
sources: instance_blackwing_descent.cpp:481-484 WriteSaveDataMore writes the raw byte after the last boss state
instance_blackwing_descent.cpp:486-505 ReadSaveDataMore reads it and respawns shields, spirits or Atramedes
save_extras.notes: NOT_STARTED is written as a NUL byte. InstanceMap::CreateInstanceData loads data.c_str(), so the NUL ends the string and the member keeps its NOT_STARTED default.

spawn_schema: dead_db_spawn_entries: entries a natural kill leaves dead as database spawns; each must have a spawn on the map and difficulty and gets a never-respawn row (null = unverified, the boss cannot be seeded done). summoned_entries: entries the script summons or spawns through a manual spawn group only while the boss is not DONE; a database spawn of one outside a manual spawn group refuses seeding.
